_comment: Copy to ~/.workbuddy-gateway/config.json (or pass --config PATH). CLI flags and environment variables override these values. Never commit a file that contains a real apiKey.
_apiKey: Optional. Leave empty to accept any client on the loopback interface. Set one if more than one local app can reach this port.
_authFile: Optional. Leave empty to auto-detect the desktop client's session file.
_models: Optional. Replace the built-in list. Verify ids with: node probes/probe-models.js --json
_models_note: The first twelve are free (credit 0 as measured 2026-09). hy4-preview without the -f suffix is billed and looks identical in the official UI, so watch the log's credit= field.
_desensitize: Rewrite security vocabulary in system/developer messages so the upstream content filter stops rejecting agent preambles.
_retryOnBlock: Retry once with heavier desensitization if the upstream still rejects the request.
_logFile: Optional. Append the structured log here as well as to stdout.
_debug: Log per-attempt detail (byte sizes, role lists, zero-width counts).
_exposeIdentity: false keeps nickname/uid out of GET /health.
